coverage.scope: All snapshot1-to-current changed lines, deletions, unified-five current neighbors, and the explicitly listed complete dependent units were read. Entire affected parent units and their resulting audience progressions were compared. This is an incremental recheck, not a regenerated full-body classification.

method.segmentation: Original annotation-masked line offsets retained. Terminal punctuation followed by an uppercase/quote start splits sentences, with common time/title abbreviations protected. Directions, screen text and stage fragments are retained. Locator precision is sentence/fragment within an original source line, not a grammatical parser guarantee.
method.table_provenance: The text was read and classified before this compact transcription. Programmatic operations enumerate the already-read selected scope and attach locators; no uninspected sentence is assigned a fresh negative by default. Dash means no clear applicable named failure found in this round, not literary perfection.
method.recheck_threshold: An old yes repaired into a new passage becomes yes again only for a clear applicable current failure. Unchanged no/ambiguous judgments are not reopened for preferences. R2-01 and R2-02 are newly written explanation duplicates, not persistence of the old P04.
method.parent_tests: Positions are P01 copied wording/imagery, P02 copied explanatory labels, P03 copied narrator/design statements, P04 borrowed opening/action sequence. ---- means no clear failure in the read paragraph's actual parent comparison; parent-set limits remain explicit. Entire multi-paragraph progressions were compared before judging short segments.
method.preserved_exceptions: Fixed basic acts, causal results, actual world values, necessary concise connections/staging and complete short utterances may be kept. Narration may add adopted judgment, irony, cost or anticipation unavailable through the scene. No new event, conflict, treaty clause, provision, anecdote or ornament is demanded merely to vary a form.
method.masking: HTML annotations are not used as classification evidence. Body is inspected with comments blanked while retaining line breaks. No author explanation, notes, draft, author/reviewer record or evidence HTML was consulted.
method.question_scope: All listed failure families are checked where applicable in the selected sentences/paragraphs. Distribution questions are considered within those affected units and their inherited parent relationships; this round makes no new whole-work distribution or population completion claim.
method.contract_provenance: Current contract hashes were observed. The six expressly listed contracts were freshly read; other unchanged questions retain their earlier direct-reading provenance, checked by current hashes. Initial bce122192 contract input attribution is not rewritten retroactively.
method.changed_dependencies: Deleted old lines and current anchors are recorded. Deletion dependencies include removed narrator speech after scene expansion, removed promised Elba speech, visitor exit state, and the two-field outcome; unchanged whole consumers are read where the changed script affects them.
